what: Behind the page, three light blobs drift at different tempos along a noise texture (1.65×, flowing .08 and −.06 per second) as a spreading haze — time ×.308, and the third blob sticks to the second and separates while cos(t·.62) is between .72 and .96. Weak light is tinted from background→dark color (.055~.5 × .7), strong light with a bright color (.22~.78 × .74), with 1.35px grain on top. 30fps, and on phones (768 or less) vertical .68 and spread 2 push the blobs further apart

options.spread-phone: Phone size, default 2 — at 1.75 or above, spreads the clusters 1.4× and raises the second by .34
options.still: Time (sec) to hold on when reduced motion is on, default 12
options.--fx-haze: Light color (css variable), default --kf-accent — Brand uses navy #010980

use: — For the page background, set position: fixed in your own css; inset: 0; z-index: -1
note: Stops when off screen or in a hidden tab. If WebGL is unavailable, an is-fx-fallback mark is added and two layers of radial gradient are used

from.where: shared.js .y-haze canvas (fixed navy haze behind the page — original c-haze shader: time ×.308 · noise 2127.1/81.17 · 1269.5/283.37 · light .84/1/.88→.64 · 30fps · dpr 1.5 · phone .68/2)
